summary: legal checked in 4 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: Risk disposition: BLOCKED for SearchWoot public beta, full launch, alert expansion, affiliate use, and advertising. Recommendation: keep SearchWoot private and preview-only; keep rights outreach unsent pending human-counsel review and owner authorization. Evidence: Woot API documentation establishes access mechanics but not rights to store, derive, cache, publicly display, alert on, or monetize deal and price-history data; current public terms restrict commercial/public collection, display, derivative use, and data mining. Human counsel is required for upstream rights, jurisdictional privacy treatment, and future affiliate or advertising use. Ordinary reversible fleet growth remains CONDITIONAL where it adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, new data collection, or cross-site behavior and preserves consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, affiliate, platform-policy, and age-sensitive boundaries. Compliance baseline is technical only: 37 pass, 16 fail, 6 unknown; failures and unknowns require site-specific evidence or remediation, but incomplete telemetry alone is not a blocker. Revenue remains $4.92 aggregate and unattributed for 2026-09-21; no site revenue, ROI, margin, or causal-lift claim is supported. Operations and security sweeps remain unavailable, so public exposure and security-sensitive releases stay blocked.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 tasks are closed and 4 remain open. No task is closed because direct evidence remains missing. Progress is limited to official source-rights review, partial repository/configuration data-flow evidence, privacy and cookie-policy artifacts, and draft site terms. Next evidence action: attach one consolidated read-only bundle covering field-level rights, deployed data flow, identifiers, retention, deletion, correction, access, notification consent, unsubscribe behavior, GA4 configuration and retention, log fields, vendors, incident/request procedures, accuracy/freshness controls, and rollback evidence; then route rights and jurisdictional gaps to human counsel.

Data-use review dispositions: Woot API deal and price-history data is BLOCKED; missing written permission or API agreement and field-level limits for storage, derivatives, caching, display, alerts, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, trademarks, images, prices, affiliate use, and advertising. Smallest next action: complete the internal counsel packet and obtain human-counsel review. User alert rules and sync results are EVIDENCE_NEEDED; missing data inventory, identifiers, retention, deletion, correction, access, processor terms, notification consent, and unsubscribe behavior. Smallest next action: produce a read-only deployed/repository data-flow and retention table. GA4 analytics is EVIDENCE_NEEDED; the stated consent-gated measurement purpose is conditionally supportable, but deployed consent and withdrawal behavior, GA4 property/data-sharing settings, retention, and jurisdictional treatment are missing. Smallest next action: capture consent and GA4 configuration evidence without enabling tracking, remarketing, or advertising. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data are EVIDENCE_NEEDED; operational use is conditionally supportable, but log fields, retention/access controls, vendor coverage, incident, subpoena, and data-subject-request procedures are missing. Smallest next action: produce a read-only log, vendor, incident, and request inventory. No secondary disclosure or monetization is cleared.

Private and parked-site decision: keep complicated.work, deadlymaracas.com, and driveford.net parked, private, preview-only, and unlaunched. No publish, deployment, DNS change, analytics configuration, monetization, spending, dependency addition, or queue entry is cleared. Existing readiness work remains open. Next evidence action: attach a dated readiness packet for each property covering ownership, preview/build, compliance, security, measurement boundary, rollback point, and explicit blocker evidence; escalate incomplete packets to CTO at the existing deadline.
